digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler binding store and rotation tracking
propositions: Introduce a dedicated rotation module that loads and persists GET-rotation state to `.bridge_state/get_rotation.json` while dual-writing legacy inline fields during rollout.
Read chronological max(sidecar_value, legacy_inline_value) for each Jira key and persist both representations through BindingStore.save() paths.
Extract outbound wrappers to keep outbound_differ.py at or below 800 lines while wiring shared rotation accessors.
Stage and commit both dual-written rotation files explicitly without git add -A in the binding-store commit path.
Preserve rollback by ensuring reverted readers ignore the sidecar but see legacy fields advanced by all new-binary passes.
An idempotent pass with no absent-key GETs leaves committed bridge-state files byte-identical and does not advance HEAD after rotation state initialization.
